official_turtle_checkpoint.role: official TURTLE BSD deblurring baseline/initialization; it does not alter the dataset split policy
official_turtle_checkpoint.incompatible_backend_warning: Do not bind this checkpoint to the current GoPro t1 backend, which has a different 633-key/59079548-parameter state contract.
official_turtle_checkpoint.weight_license: not separately stated on the official trained-model download page

image_contract.materialization_audit_rule: Every authorized train/valid member must pass ZIP CRC and PNG IHDR validation; this contract has not been evaluated on test member payloads.

split_policy.test_pixel_exposure_definition: Opening, decompressing, hashing, decoding, copying, displaying, or supplying any test member payload to a model or evaluator constitutes test pixel exposure. HEAD requests, ZIP central-directory metadata reads, opaque whole-archive transfer, and an opaque whole-archive SHA-256 do not constitute semantic test pixel exposure.
allowed_before_evaluation_protocol_freez: HTTP HEAD of the pinned object
HTTP Range reads limited to the pinned ZIP central directory and ZIP trailer
opaque byte-for-byte transfer of the complete archive into quarantine
whole-archive byte count and SHA-256 for an append-only acquisition receipt
materialization and audit of train and valid members only
forbidden_before_evaluation_protocol_fre: open or decompress any test member payload
hash any individual test member payload
decode, inspect, display, copy, or evaluate any test image
make the quarantined archive generally readable

archive_content_sha256.reason: The official publisher does not provide a checksum and the object has not yet been acquired.
archive_content_sha256.binding_rule: The first complete acquisition records SHA-256 in an append-only receipt. The frozen source identity, byte count, and remote ZIP metadata identity must already pass before transfer; the protocol file itself is never mutated.

license_audit.dataset_license: not explicitly stated by the official README, paper, or download page
license_audit.required_publication_action: Cite the BSD papers and obtain or document dataset-use/redistribution permission before redistributing images or an archive.
